title: Piezoelectric stiffening: pulse speed c_D in a shorted strip (two-way, analytic)
description:
A 6 mm strip along x (600 cells of 10 um, periodic y of 4 cells, rigid x walls) of one piezoelectric solid (rho 4700, c11 = 200 GPa, eps_dc 10, piezo_e11 = e only: P = e S_xx), electrostatics grounded on both x faces (shorted electrodes), electrostatics_acoustics_piezo two-way (back_action bound_charge: the bound charge -div(e S) re-solves the electrostatics every acoustic step). A Ricker traction sheet (10 MHz) at 1.5 mm launches a plane P pulse each way; the probes sit 1 and 2 mm to the right, and the run ends before any wall echo reaches them (the x_lo echo would reach probe_1 at ~0.95 us at e = 2.1; ~860-950 steps per run, one warm-started multigrid CG solve per step).
Analytic: with both ends grounded and pinned walls, D = e <S> = 0, so E = -e S / (eps0 eps) and T = (c11 + e^2 / (eps0 eps)) S: the pulse travels at the stiffened c_D = sqrt((c11 + e^2 / (eps0 eps)) / rho) (7290 m/s at e = 2.1, K^2 = 0.2) instead of c_E = sqrt(c11 / rho) (6523 m/s), with v_x = T / (2 rho c_D) s(t - t0 - r / c_D) (s the Ricker wavelet, t0 = 4 / f0); the potential carried by the pulse is V = e u / (eps0 eps), u = the displacement (u = v0 tau exp(-(pi f0 tau)^2)).
Derived values tab: travel_1 / travel_2 = travel times sheet -> probe by a first-order matched-filter delay (r / c_D plus the delay estimate -integral of v s'(t - t_pred) / (v0 integral of s'^2)) vs r / c_D, expected ~1-2e-3 long (grid dispersion at ~70 cells per wavelength and the discrete stiffening e^2 / (eps0 eps) cos^2(k h / 2) both slow the pulse, more at the high-frequency end of the Ricker spectrum), tolerance 5e-3; m2_matched (amplitude and shape, 1 expected, 2 %). With back_action none (one-way, switch it in the coupling) the pulse runs at c_E: the travel times come out ~11 % long and every check fails, as it should; at e = 0.7 c_D is only 1.4 % above c_E, still ~3x the tolerance.
Probes tab: probe_1 / probe_2 (v_x) with the dashed stiffened pulses (~1-2 % of the range from the dispersion delay); electrostatics.potential_1 with the dashed e u / (eps0 eps) (~3 %: the delay plus the cell-centre / half-step sampling).
Sweep tab: travel_2 versus piezo_e11 (0.7, 1.4, 2.1 C/m^2: c_D - c_E ~ e^2) with the dashed travel_2_vs_e (its error is measured against the 28 ns range of the curve, so ~2 % there).

parameters.name: f0
parameters.description: Ricker peak frequency of the sheet

parameters.name: t0_r
parameters.description: time of the Ricker maximum at the sheet (400 ns)

parameters.name: T_sheet
parameters.description: peak traction of the sheet in Pa

parameters.name: rho_p
parameters.description: density in kg/m^3

parameters.name: c11_p
parameters.description: stiffness c11 = c22 at constant field (c^E) in Pa

parameters.name: c12_p
parameters.description: stiffness c12 in Pa

parameters.name: c66_p
parameters.description: shear stiffness c66 in Pa (not excited)

parameters.name: eps_p
parameters.description: relative static permittivity eps_dc (clamped)

parameters.name: e11_p
parameters.description: piezoelectric constant piezo_e11 in C/m^2 (swept)

parameters.name: stiff_p
parameters.description: piezoelectric stiffening e^2 / (eps0 eps) in Pa (49.8 GPa at e = 2.1)

parameters.name: c_D
parameters.description: stiffened P speed in m/s (7290 at e = 2.1)

parameters.name: c_E
parameters.description: unstiffened P speed in m/s (6523; one-way coupling)

parameters.name: v0
parameters.description: velocity amplitude T / (2 rho c_D) on each side in m/s

parameters.name: V_scale
parameters.description: potential per unit u / v0 [V/s]: V = V_scale tau exp(-(pi f0 tau)^2)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length (rigid walls at both ends)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: strip height (periodic y: plane waves)

parameters.name: y_mid
parameters.description: y of the probes (a cell centre)

parameters.name: x_s
parameters.description: sheet position (cell centre; its normal traction sits on the two x faces of the cell)

parameters.name: r1
parameters.description: distance sheet -> v_x node of probe_1 (its cell's +x face)

parameters.name: r2
parameters.description: distance sheet -> v_x node of probe_2

parameters.name: t1
parameters.description: stiffened pulse centre time at probe_1

parameters.name: t2
parameters.description: stiffened pulse centre time at probe_2

parameters.name: t1_centre
parameters.description: pulse centre time at the probe_1 cell centre (the potential probe)

parameters.name: E_ric
parameters.description: Ricker energy: integral of s^2 dt in s

parameters.name: E_dot
parameters.description: integral of s'^2 dt in 1/s (the delay estimate's norm)

parameters.name: T_run
parameters.description: study duration: past probe_2's pulse (t2 + 1.2 / f0 at e = 0.7) and before the x_lo wall echo reaches probe_1 (t0_r + (2*x_s + r1) / c_D - 1.2 / f0 at e = 2.1)
